author: HBO Max
description:
On Season 1, Episode 6 of the Stuart Fails to Save the Universe Official Podcast, Felicia Day and Wil Wheaton welcome director Jonathan Frakes for behind-the-scenes access to “Spoiler: Corn Is Delicious,” SFTSTU’s gloriously strange cow universe. The longtime Star Trek: The Next Generation collaborators get into the void sequence that had to be rebuilt and reshot, the old-school trick behind two Kevin Sussmans sharing a scene, and the gentle Stuart-and-Denise moment that finally pushes Stuart toward becoming a hero.

Big Bang Theory fans also get plenty to nerd out about, from Kunal Nayyar’s wildly different take on Raj to Barry Kripke’s unexpected role in the group and the mystery of Stuart Prime. It is a comic book multiverse conversation packed with superhero storytelling, gross-out comedy, and real insight into how this cast and crew made the episode work.
